definitions: Thin, transparent coatings applied to pottery or other materials to make them impervious or decorative.
Smooth, glossy coatings of sugar or other ingredients applied to food.
Thin, transparent layers of paint applied over a dry underlayer to modify the tone or color.
examples: The artist applied several glazes to the ceramic.
The baker prepared various glazes for the pastries.
The painting technique involved multiple glazes.
